card.text: The secondary star of OGLE-LMC-ECL-09114, a pair that eclipse each other every 214.366 days.

introduction.text: It has 3.205 solar masses and 18.79 solar radii; its partner has 3.304 and 26.33, measured from the eclipses and the stars' motions.
